name: crewloom
description: Project-bound agent roles, context, memory and verified workflows through the installed Crewloom CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Project context, roles and verified workflows
interface.longDescription: Use your installed Crewloom CLI for project-bound roles, source-linked context, working memory and isolated checks. Requires Git, Python and the Crewloom runtime; Docker is needed for isolated acceptance. This plugin does not grant desktop tools or install a model provider.
defaultPrompt: Use Crewloom to inspect this project's task, select a role and verify the result.
